headline: Qualcomm Shares Fall on Apple Business Loss and High Memory Costs
summary: Qualcomm's stock declines as the company faces the loss of Apple's business alongside the negative impact of high memory costs on overall smartphone demand.
why: Qualcomm is a major semiconductor designer supplying mobile processors and wireless technology to the global smartphone industry, making its supply chain relationships and component costs critical for tech sector valuations.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: The input explicitly states that Qualcomm's stock falls due to pressure on sales from twin forces.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Qualcomm shares fell as investors reacted to the prospective loss of a major customer and rising memory costs dampening broader smartphone demand.
